messages:
aya: FYI hitting SchemaValidationError in python-sdk 0.24 when models return numbers as strings in tool calls. Affects our onboarding samples.

kevin: Minimal repro? fn.call or tool.call?

aya: tool.call, expects int but got "5". Previously coerced.

mike: Confirmed. Looks like stricter validation landed in PR #537. We should add a compatibility path.

kevin: Proposal: add `coerce_primitives` per-call flag + client-level default. Keep default strict for now.

aya: Also please include raw token snippet in exception metadata so customers can debug generated output.

mike: I'll take sync impl, add tests for empty string/null/true->bool. Kevin can add client option and changelog note.

doc-bot: Created issue #792: python-sdk - primitive coercion opt-in + error diagnostics.

kevin: We'll also emit telemetry `sdk.coercion_used` when coercion happens (no payload).

aya: Thanks, ping me on the PR. This will unblock our sample apps. :pray:
